remarks: The well-maintained Pinewood Estates community is conveniently located between the downtown Stamford area and the Newfield Shopping Center. This three level end-unit town home features two very spacious bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a half bath on the main level. The spacious living room features hardwood floors, a wood burning fireplace, and sliders that lead to the balcony overlooking the community courtyard and swimming pool. The dining room has plenty of space for a large dining table set and is located directly off the kitchen. The eat-in kitchen has a convenient pantry and plenty of cabinet space. Upstairs, the en-suite bathroom located in the primary bedroom is newly renovated with a beautiful glass stall shower. The over-sized primary bedroom is sunlit thanks to the sliding doors looking into the courtyard. The second bedrooms is also very large with a roomy french door closet. There is a room on the lower level that could be used as an office, playroom or guest bedroom. It has a walk-out to the patio area. The beautiful in-ground swimming pool is well maintain and features a convenient pool house. This unit has an attached garage with additional space for storage, plus there is an additional assigned space located directly in front of the unit. There is ample visitor parking as well. The special assessment for recent improvements is paid in full.
